annotations.title: Find a time for a free call with Nikita

description: Returns Nikita Marushkov's open times for a free 30-minute video call (Google Meet): Monday to Friday, 10 AM–6 PM Eastern (the last call starts at 5 PM), at least 4 hours ahead and up to two weeks out. Each time has an exact start to pass to book_call. Give the user's time zone to see the times in their own time zone too.

from_date.description: Optional: the first day to look at, as YYYY-MM-DD, within the next two weeks. Leave empty for the next open times.

time_zone.description: Optional: the user's time zone, e.g. America/Chicago or Europe/London.
